title: Unmarked Blackhawks during NOTAM experiments

tellings.quote: I mean, when you have Blackhawk helicopters, unmarked Blackhawk helicopters showing up in the middle of the night,

plain: Unmarked Black Hawk helicopters turned up in the middle of the night at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, while experiments there were under way with NOTAMs in place (a NOTAM is an official notice that warns pilots about an area of airspace). The ranch's owner, who is not named in the tellings, says he saw this and tells Michels: "unmarked Blackhawk helicopters showing up in the middle of the night." If true, someone with military aircraft was quietly keeping an eye on what happened at the ranch.
